title: The Chain, Not the Signature: code and data
description: Measurement code, firmware, raw results and table generators for the paper The Chain, Not the Signature: Cost and Validation of Post-Quantum Content Credentials. It covers the size and timing of C2PA manifests under ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, Falcon and composite signatures on an Apple M1 Pro, a Xeon VM, a Raspberry Pi 5 and three microcontrollers; the validation matrix through a patched c2pa-rs; and the scripts that regenerate every table and number in the paper.
